insights.title: Market Snapshot
insights.subtitle: OEM parts demand keeps climbing. Here are a few highlights.

items.q: What types of auto parts do you specialise in?
items.a: Our MVP focuses on high-demand body panels and lighting (headlamps, tail-lamps, bumpers, fenders) from trusted Taiwanese OEM-approved factories.

items.q: Are your parts OEM or aftermarket?
items.a: All items meet or exceed SAE/DOT standards and are produced in ISO-certified facilities, giving you OEM-level fit and finish at aftermarket pricing.

items.q: How long does delivery to the US take?
items.a: Our strategic Dubai hub ensures very fast shipping to your door without customs headaches.

items.q: Is there a minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
items.a: Yes. To secure factory-direct pricing we currently operate on full-container or skid-lot quantities (≈ USD 40k). Mixed-model containers are allowed.

items.q: Can I mix different models/part numbers in one container?
items.a: Absolutely. We’ll work with you to build a mixed SKU manifest so you can stock a sensible spread of high-turn items.
Customer funds are deposited into escrow. Once your shipment is confirmed on board, funds are released to us and production/dispatch begins.
For the MVP we operate on escrow/pre-paid terms. Credit programs will roll out after consistent order history (≈3 containers).
We back every part with a standard 12-month warranty against manufacturing defects. Extended plans available for volume clients.
Yes—if a part arrives damaged or does not fit the specified vehicle, we arrange replacement or credit. Full return guidelines are in the supply agreement.

items.q: Which US ports do you ship to?
items.a: Los Angeles, Long Beach, Houston, Newark (NY/NJ) and Savannah. Inland drayage to your facility can be quoted on request.

items.q: Can I brand the packaging with my logo?
items.a: Private-label options are available for repeat clients. MOQ for custom prints is typically 300 units per part number.

items.q: How are duties and customs handled?
items.a: Our forwarder files all ISF and entry paperwork. Duties (2.5 % ad valorem on most parts) are billed at cost; we’ll guide you through every step.

items.q: Do you provide fitment data or catalog feeds?
items.a: Yes—CSV/XML fitment tables (year/make/model) and hi-res imagery are included so you can update your webshop instantly.

items.q: Is drop-shipping to my customers possible?
items.a: Large-parcel drop-ship from our US 3PL is slated for phase 2. Join the wait-list and we’ll notify you when live.
